text:
Which statement about waves is correct?
A
Waves do not transfer either energy or matter.
B
Waves transfer both energy and matter.
C
Waves transfer energy without transferring matter.
D
Waves transfer matter without transferring energy.

options.label: A
options.text: Waves do not transfer either energy or matter.

options.label: B
options.text: Waves transfer both energy and matter.

options.label: C
options.text: Waves transfer energy without transferring matter.

options.label: D
options.text: Waves transfer matter without transferring energy.
